Nina: Quick heads-up 1 I opened a PR to tidy the Private install KMS/HSM section and add a tiny 'egress smoke' checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2718
Rahul: Thanks. Can we add a minimal nftables + curl healthcheck for air-gapped customers? Keeps support calls down.
Nina: Yep. Draft snippet: ```
# nftables (ubuntu 22)
add table inet rw_kms
add chain inet rw_kms input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
add rule inet rw_kms input ip saddr 10.60.0.0/24 tcp dport 23456 ct state new,established accept
```
Kai: Include systemd override hint for kms-proxy and a note to use TLS_KEY_PATH instead of inline keys.
June: Small editorial: standardize heading to "HSM" and prefer "Transit Gateway" phrasing. Also avoid real ARNs/slot IDs.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed. Ready to merge.
Nina: Merged and backported to release/1.2.x. Closing thread.
